columns.label: Icon cards area (2 cards per dropdown)

types: Veículos: large megamenu with featured area + category tabs + vehicle carousel (9 vehicles)
Concessionárias: 2 icon cards + dealer search form

notes: All 5 nav dropdowns + hamburger panel follow a consistent 2-section layout: LEFT has icon cards (image+text), RIGHT has text links in 2-column grid. Exception: Veículos has a large megamenu with left featured vehicle area (image+specs, updates on carousel hover) and right section with category filter tabs + vehicle thumbnail carousel. Concessionárias also has a dealer search form with radio buttons. No overlay/backdrop. All panels are full-width (1440px). Header background changes to solid white when any panel is open.
